## Safety checklist

- [ ] No ROM, BIOS, save state, extracted assets, private trace, or ROM-derived binary was added.
- [ ] `generated/**` was not hand-edited.
- [ ] No address/mode/range was guessed.
- [ ] Generic hardware/recompiler fixes were placed upstream or clearly separated.
- [ ] Documentation/roadmap updated where status changed.
- [ ] Strict/static status is reported honestly.
